Evaluation: CIM, 1977, #10
Product Improvement on Low Tar Cigarettes

Implementation

The CIM submitted by Hal E. Guess has been evaluated by selected development personnel. Their comments are summarized below:

1. Modification to high speed making equipment would be needed. How hard this would be is unknown.

Need and/or Uniqueness

2. Inventories of an additional material and the associated problems thereof would have to be considered.

3. Additional processing equipment would be needed for the G-7 process to make the bobbins.

4. Machine efficiencies in the making and G-7 processing areas may suffer.

2. If amount of visible smoke is reduced significantly, this should have good consumer acceptance.

Economics

Whether the potential tobacco savings offset the added costs of materials and what is felt would be lowered machine efficiencies would have to be proved.

ACTION:

1. This may or may not be a good way to improve flavor. It is felt this will be hard to prove. The basic idea of a "flavor cone" has marketing appeal.

It is recommended the author proceed to the prototype stage and try to answer the flavor and sidestream smoke question before going further.

AJRI FORM 2422-Rev. 7/70
